answer: The strongest lever is simple: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because sable only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice tide is enforced by the ledger itself: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
